Thought: Let me analyze each hypothesis against the document segments.

- nda-13 (Permissible acquirement of similar information): No mention of acquiring similar info from third parties. NotMentioned.
- nda-10 (Confidentiality of Agreement): No mention of not disclosing the fact of the Agreement. NotMentioned.
- nda-12 (Permissible development of similar information): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-16 (Return of confidential information): No mention of return/destruction upon termination. NotMentioned.
- nda-3 (Inclusion of verbally conveyed information): Segment [7] says "provided verbally or in any other way not reduced in writing". Entailment, evidence [7].
- nda-17 (Permissible copy): No mention of copying. NotMentioned.
- nda-15 (No licensing): No explicit statement that no rights granted. NotMentioned.
- nda-2 (None-inclusion of non-technical information): Segment [3] includes "services, customers etc" which is non-technical. So hypothesis "Confidential Information shall only include technical information" is Contradicted by [3].
- nda-19 (Survival of obligations): No mention of survival. NotMentioned.
- nda-18 (No solicitation): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-20 (Permissible post-agreement possession): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-4 (Limited use): Segment [10] "No Use: Recipient agrees not to use the Confidential Information in any way" — combined with [5] purpose. Actually [10] says not to use in any way or share with Third Party. The limited use hypothesis: shall not use for any purpose other than stated purposes. Segment [10] supports no use except... hmm. [10] says not to use in any way. That entails limited use arguably. Evidence [10] (and [5]). I'd say Entailment with [10].
- nda-1 (Explicit identification): Segment [7] "Confidential Information as identified and reduced in writing or provided verbally or in any other way not reduced in writing" — "as identified" suggests identification. But "All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified" — the inclusion of verbally/not reduced in writing contradicts express identification? The hypothesis is about explicit identification. Since info can be provided verbally or not reduced in writing, not all is expressly identified in writing. But "as identified" still suggests identification. This is ambiguous. Typically in these NDA tasks, nda-1 is Contradiction because info "not reduced in writing" is included. Evidence [7]. I'll go with Contradiction, evidence [7].
- nda-7 (Sharing with third-parties): Segment [10] says not to share with any Third Party. So hypothesis "may share some with third-parties" is Contradiction, evidence [10].
- nda-5 (Sharing with employees): No mention of employees. NotMentioned.
- nda-11 (No reverse engineering): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-8 (Notice on compelled disclosure): Segment [11] says even if authorized under law, need express permission of Discloser — but no notification requirement. NotMentioned.
